sources.title: Visa-free access or visa-on-arrival for HKSAR passport
sources.publisher: Immigration Department, Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region
sources.officialityEvidence: The current official HKSAR Passport VFA/VOA CSV is a positive destination list. Its specification does not provide a separately reproducible visa-free versus visa-on-arrival issuance field for every destination.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Visa-free access or visa-on-arrival for HKSAR passport
